title: InvoicePilot - micro-SaaS for freelancer invoicing with 210 free users and 14 paying
description: InvoicePilot is a Django + Stripe invoicing tool for freelancers. 14 paying subscribers at $9/mo, 210 free accounts, organic traffic from two blog posts that rank. Owner spends ~2 hrs/week on support. Selling due to focus on a new venture. Includes domain, codebase, Stripe account handover, and 30 days of transition support.

title: TabSnooze - Chrome extension SaaS with 5,800 weekly active users, pre-revenue
description: TabSnooze is a tab-management Chrome extension (JavaScript/TypeScript, Firebase backend) with 5,800 WAU and a 4.6-star rating. Pre-revenue but has a built-in paywall ready to flip on ($2.99/mo pro tier). Near-zero running costs (~$8/mo Firebase). Neglected for 8 months; users still growing organically from the Chrome Web Store.

title: UptimePing - server monitoring SaaS, $310 MRR, runs itself
description: UptimePing monitors websites and pings owners on Slack/email when they go down. Rust backend on a single $20/mo VPS, React dashboard. 47 paying customers ($5-$15 plans), $310 MRR, 2% monthly churn. Fully automated onboarding and billing; owner spends under 1 hr/week. Priced at ~1.2x annual profit for a fast sale before a career move.
